name: 最近の検索セクション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0003 最近の検索セクション for reusing a heading and two recent-place rows.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screen controls icon geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and small control anatomy. Relevant source region x39 y395 width1101 height501. Its Recent section has a heading, a circled information i at the top right, and two rows with neutral history-clock discs. Input2 is our rough Japanese mock: secondary for Japanese content and overall localized layout. Correct its omissions: restore the original top-right circled information icon; do not copy its mint/green history icons. Input3 approved bus design is STYLE ONLY, not content.
Text verbatim, all Japanese: heading "最近の検索"; row1 title "中目黒の集会所", subtitle "東京都目黒区"; row2 title "代々木の交流センター", subtitle "東京都渋谷区". No other text or invented controls. Maintain exactly two rows. Each row: original clean circular clock outline, hands upward and lower-right, pale neutral gray disc on left; two aligned text lines on right; thin neutral separator inset to text column. Header title at left, original clean circled-i utility icon aligned right. Do not omit information icon, substitute dots or add chevrons/search/keyboard.
Pure-white #FFFFFF canvas and a rounded white section surface with faint neutral outline and soft restrained downward shadow, compact readable arrangement. Supporting icons uniformly #526173. No green/mint clock discs; no selected state exists, so omit colored accents. Original blue contact action outside this section is excluded.
Locked Japanese type: Meiryo, heading Bold20/28, row titles Regular14/24, metadata Regular12/16, tracking0. Keep Japanese single-line wrapping as observed, no broad bolding. Main text #1D1D1D, metadata #6E6E6E. Preserve source control proportions while localizing text. High-resolution flat frontal component only, landscape around3:2 with modest white margins. No device frame or brand label.
reviewNotes: 原参照を図形・光学的太さ・細部の優先入力に使用。モックで欠落した右上の情報アイコンを復元し履歴時計を中立グレー円＋スレートへ。選択状態がないため緑とミントを省略。最近の検索、2件の日本語地名と住所、時計、情報操作、区切りを視認。文字欠け・余計な行なし。白カード・控えめな境界と影。静止画像のエージェントレビューのみ、所有者承認・厳密フォント一致・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
